quotes.text: But then organizations scaled. 50 developers, 100, 500, and the model broke. DevOps promised shared responsibility, but what it actually delivered was distributed complexity.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Sums up why DevOps alone breaks down in large enterprises.

quotes.text: A golden path is the simplest, most supported way to get a task done. It is not the only way. You still have escape hatches for the weird edge cases.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A crisp, quotable definition of the golden path concept.

quotes.text: Golden paths eliminate the constraint by removing choice where choice adds no value. Developers make decisions about their application. The infrastructure team made the decisions about infrastructure.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains how golden paths separate application and infrastructure decisions.

quotes.text: Adoption you earn is better than adoption you force. When developers choose to use the platform because it is genuinely easier than the alternative, adoption is voluntary and sustainable.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A clear principle for running an internal platform as a product.

quotes.text: Platform engineering eliminates that bottleneck, not by hiring more people to say yes, but by automating the yes itself, by encoding those decisions into templates, by making governance a part of the deployment
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Captures the episode's core thesis of automating approvals through templates.

takeaways: DevOps at enterprise scale shifted infrastructure complexity onto developers, and platform engineering fixes this by treating infrastructure as a product developers consume through golden paths.
Azure Bicep modules, Azure Verified Modules, Azure Policy as code, versioned registries and CI/CD pipelines encode security and compliance so the right way becomes the only easy way.
Platform teams must run their internal developer platform as a product, earning adoption rather than forcing it and measuring DORA metrics, satisfaction, adoption and cost avoidance together.
hook: DevOps gave developers cloud autonomy but also buried them in networking, security, policy and approval queues. This episode shows Azure platform teams, architects and engineering leaders how platform engineering, golden paths, Bicep modules and automated governance remove that cognitive load and turn ops from gatekeeper into enabler.
